name: Person
definition: An individual human being, such as an athlete, artist, politician, or other professional.

name: Biological Taxon
definition: A group of living organisms, such as a species, genus, or family, including animals and plants.

name: Geographical Feature
definition: A natural physical formation on the Earth's surface, such as a mountain, river, lake, or volcano.

name: Settlement
definition: A community or administrative division where people live, such as a village, town, or city.

name: Building or Structure
definition: A man-made construction, such as a building, bridge, church, or ruin.

name: Educational Institution
definition: An organization or establishment dedicated to education, such as a school, college, or university.

name: Organization
definition: An organized body of people with a particular purpose, such as a company, charity, bank, or government agency.

name: Vehicle
definition: A machine used for transportation on land, water, or in the air, including ships, aircraft, cars, and trains.

name: Musical Work
definition: A musical recording or composition, such as an album, EP, or music video compilation.

name: Film/TV
definition: A motion picture or television production, including films, documentaries, and television specials.

name: Written Work
definition: A written or published creative work or periodical, such as a novel, play, newspaper, or magazine.

name: Concept
definition: An abstract idea, term, or notion, rather than a physical object or person.
